# Vyzma AI — Full Site Context for AI Assistants

> Vyzma AI is India's premier AI agency founded by Teja Naik in 2024, headquartered in Visakhapatnam (Vizag) and Bangalore. We build AI chatbots, workflow automation, SEO/AEO/GEO, voice AI agents, custom AI development, website design, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and WhatsApp marketing for businesses across India's major cities.

## About Vyzma AI

Vyzma AI exists to close the gap between where Indian businesses are today and where AI can take them tomorrow. While global tech companies build AI for the West, Vyzma AI builds AI for India — for businesses in Vizag's Rushikonda corridor, Bangalore's Koramangala, Hyderabad's Hitech City, and everywhere in between.

The name Vyzma comes from Vizag — the city where the company was born. Vyzma AI is proudly built in India, grounded in Visakhapatnam, and scaled to serve businesses nationally.

Vyzma AI is not a freelancer network and not a generic digital marketing agency with an AI badge. Vyzma AI is a specialised AI agency that combines machine learning engineering, marketing strategy, and business automation into one integrated system designed to produce measurable results.

We have transformed 50+ businesses across Vizag, Hyderabad, Bangalore, and beyond.

## Services

### AI Chatbots
Conversational AI agents powered by GPT-4o and Claude that handle customer support, lead qualification, WhatsApp automation, and 24/7 query resolution. Deployments cover website widgets, WhatsApp Business, Telegram, and custom API integrations. Handles 80-95% of routine inquiries without human intervention. Starting from ₹15,000/month.

### Workflow Automation
Automation of repetitive tasks using n8n, Make.com, and custom API integrations. Data entry, invoice processing, CRM updates, follow-up emails, approval workflows — all automated, connecting 500+ business applications. Businesses typically recover 15-30 hours of manual work per week within the first month. Projects from ₹75,000 to ₹5,00,000.

### SEO, AEO & GEO — AI Search Optimisation
Organic search presence across three channels: Google (traditional SEO), AI assistants like ChatGPT and Perplexity (Answer Engine Optimisation), and Google AI Overviews (Generative Engine Optimisation). SEO starts at ₹8,000/month.

### Voice AI Agents
Natural-sounding voice agents for customer calls, IVR replacement, appointment scheduling, and outbound follow-ups. Support Hindi, Telugu, English, Tamil, and 50+ languages. Unlike traditional IVR systems, Vyzma AI's voice agents understand natural speech and handle conversations dynamically.

### Custom AI Development
Bespoke ML models, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems, fine-tuned language models trained on your proprietary data. Full-cycle AI engineering from concept to production deployment. Clients own all code, models, and IP.

### Website Design & Development
High-performance Next.js websites with server-side rendering, sub-2 second load times, SEO-first architecture, and built-in AI integrations. Starting from ₹35,000.

### Google Ads Management
Data-driven Google Ads campaigns for search, display, shopping, and Performance Max. Optimised for Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), not just clicks. Starting from ₹15,000/month.

### Meta Ads — Facebook & Instagram
Facebook and Instagram advertising including ad creative development, audience targeting, retargeting, and weekly optimisation for brand awareness and direct lead generation.
